newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL'S JOHNSON SIGNS FOR LEICESTERSHIRE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL'S JOHNSON SIGNS FOR LEICESTERSHIRE.

text.p: English county side Leicestershire have signed Natal all-rounder Neil Johnson as their new overseas player.
Johnson, 27, replaces West Indies all-rounder Phil Simmons on a one-year contract.
"It's all been a bit of surprise really," Johnson, a medium pacer, said on Wednesday.
"I got back from a trip to Zimbabwe this weekend and Natal coach Graham Ford had a message for me saying that Leicestershire were quite keen on me...all I had to do was sign."
